verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-LLM-ready-text API. It uses AI for content conversion: VLM image captioning, and ReaderLM-v2 field extraction via x-instruction or x-json-schema. None of the evidence shows it generating insights or suggestions about a user's data inside the product, so these features are adjacent transformation and extraction capabilities, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
